content.text: I'll resolve these three equipment points to their timeseries ids.

input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/ref#>
SELECT ?uri ?name ?ts WHERE {
  ?uri rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER (contains(?name, "Chiller02") || contains(?name, "HWPump02") || contains(?name, "SupplyFan_AHU03"))
  ?uri ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts
}
